in_hebrew.name: חדווה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Drawn from or derived from the Hebrew root 'hadav' (חדב), which means 'to give,' 'to pour out,' 'to love,' 'to have mercy,' or 'to be gracious.' This name, Hedvah, can be interpreted as 'beloved' or 'one who pours out love.'

in_greek.name: Hedvah
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God's gift
in_greek.long_meaning: Hedvah είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. In Hebrew, Hedvah means 'my delight is in God.' This name is a reminder of the joy and gratitude we should feel when we receive God's blessings.

in_latin.name: Hedvah
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God's gift
in_latin.long_meaning: Hedvah est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. In Hebrew, Hedvah means 'my delight is in God.' This name is a reminder of the joy and gratitude we should feel when we receive God's blessings.
